input.title: Truth Ocean sprinter 711RS
input.descriptionHtml:
This model offers a sharp casting feeling, outstanding distance, manual operation feel and speedy lift.

For anglers who prefer a faster action.

The current OceanSprinter 838/8110 was developed with the primary focus on ease of catching fish and ease of control.

The new 711 is designed for ease of casting and operability, especially for poppers (HAMMERHEAD C/D/E and other diving poppers (HAMMERHEAD Jakure / NativeWorks The tone is specialized for the operability of Napalm 220, 250, etc.
Of course, with ingenuity and fine-tuning on the angler's side, it can also be used for diving pencil operation.

The blank repulsion has been increased, improving the response of manual operation of lures and other actions.
It is set to a short length so that it can be used comfortably for long periods of time.

After a hit, the blank repulsion is used to create a tone that can handle faster developments.
The degree of completion is high from the prototype No. 1, and in 2019, we have been fishing in various fields with the help of our collaborators.

There is no room for improvement in the development concept, and it has been completed as a wonderful model.

As you can imagine, when casting, the release point and sweet spot are also narrow. (Personally, I think that around 140g is the easiest and most comfortable way to cast.) If you are confident in your strength, you can cast it further than the indication below.

It is also possible to perform a diving pencil action that cannot be expressed with a soft tip.
I feel that it is also effective for casting yellowtail that preys on large bait.

(RS: response It is an abbreviation for "Reaction", "Response", and "Good response!".

Note: Although it is a hard and resilient blank, it is not as sticky as the WhiteInsight series, so please be careful not to stand it up too much when fighting directly below.
